measurements.policy: Signed median-strip gradient cosine on final rendered candidates. Frozen scan pose; eight fixed art/paper boundary windows, no additional image fitting. Color error is Oklab distance ×100 over fixed frame texture windows, reported separately.

policy: All 25 Revised land printings. Thirteen calibration, twelve held-out. Frozen scan transforms and exact scan/render hashes; no scan refitting to candidate lettering. Whole-card structural index is separate from color and does not certify legal text.

paperFit.policy: Shared paper rectangle fit on calibration scans only; frozen reference poses and signed strip gradients.

limitations: Existing frame texture and source-art colors still differ from scans.
Paper band colors transfer shared basic-land profiles; no individual dual-land color fitting.
Whole-card structure is a similarity index, not a percentage of correctness.
Rejected basic-land typography refit retained at prior default after held-out regression.
